verdict.summary: The combined abox+cdomain path is sound as scoped. Exact-numeric DataPropertyAssertion literals are collected only for the real ABox decoding path, minted through the same canonical point-range registry as TBox ranges, and internalized as the valid consequence {a} ⊑ ∃q.{v}; unsupported literals remain counted skips. The emit cutoff preserves all relevant containment axioms because newly appended ABox ranges are singleton points and cannot properly contain a distinct non-empty canonical range. Feature isolation is preserved, and the focused tests exercise positive range propagation, negative non-containment, concept deduplication, inconsistency detection, deferral, and the TBox-only path.
